name: Petrushka
source: One of the five gynoids containing [url=/c7182]Ruili[/url]'s soul data.  Petrushka belongs to [url=/c7186]Ng Wing Shing[/url] - a memento of the rape and murder of Kong Ruili one year prior. Ng's dress-up doll and assistant. [spoiler]Petrushka is a heavily modified combat gynoid, devised by Ng as a defensive measure against [url=/c7177]Kong Taoluo[/url]. Her limbs contain scythe-like blades and high-caliber machine guns.[/spoiler]
